_doc: Promotion-pipeline config (dev → stage → main). DATA file, like polecat-platform's .github/steward/focus.json — editing it is a sanctioned direct commit to main (sessions: pull → edit → push; Manager: contents-API PUT with sha compare-and-swap). Changes take effect on the next hourly tick of promote-to-stage.yml. Fields: promoteToStage.enabled turns the scheduled dev→stage promotion on/off entirely; paused is a soft hold (schedule keeps ticking, does nothing); everyHours is the cadence; offset anchors which UTC hour the cadence counts from; window [start,end) limits promotions to those UTC hours. Manual dispatches of promote-to-stage.yml ignore the schedule (but respect nothing else here). stage→prod promotion is promote-to-prod.yml, dispatch-only, and refuses while the latest stage promotion run is red unless requireGreenStageForProd is false or the dispatch passes force.

gates.devGate: node .github/validate.mjs + node .github/smoke-test.mjs (ci.yml on PRs into dev and pushes to dev)
